# Parts list

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/agents/parts-list.mjs write` from docs/agents/parts.json and the code. Do not edit by hand: npm test fails when it is out of date. -->

Every UI component of the editor, so you find the one that exists before you build another.

**Reuse before new.** Building or changing UI starts here:

1. A part or shared piece fits: use it.
2. It nearly fits: extend it (a new option, a variant or a default in its own files), never copy its look into a screen.
3. Nothing fits: add a new part with a reason in the PR, as a new entry in `docs/agents/parts.json` (then run the write
   command above). A screen may place and size a part; it may not give it a look of its own.

When copies of one look differ slightly, the most used look wins. Home-made copies are counted per file and may only
go down (`node scripts/agents/copies.mjs report` lists them; `npm test` fails when they rise). The target shape and the
plan for moving each part into its own folder: [parts-plan.md](parts-plan.md).

## Parts: reuse these first

### Button

- **For:** Any action a person clicks: a filled primary action or a quiet secondary one, with words and optionally an icon.
- **Not for:** A link that leaves the editor (use `link()` beside it), or an icon alone (no icon button part yet: see Copies to swap).
- **Use:** `button(text, action, className = "button secondary")` from `src/ui/dom.ts`; `link(text, href, className = "button primary")` for an `<a>` with the same look. A screen that needs it to differ sets a `--btn-*` hook in its own CSS.
- **Variants:** tone: primary (class `button` or `button primary`), secondary (`button secondary`, the default of `button()`); disabled is plain, not a pale tone
- **Code:** `src/ui/dom.ts`
- **Styles:** `src/ui/parts/button.css`
- **Tests:** `tests/catalogue-css-file.test.ts`, `tests/editor-css-layers.test.ts`
- **Design board:** Atoms › Button
- **Copies to swap:** buttons made with `node("button")` and button looks styled in screens (`node scripts/agents/copies.mjs report`); `.icon-button` and `.text-button` in `src/style.css` are the next parts to make (icon button, text button).

### Icon

- **For:** A Phosphor Regular icon by name, alone or standing before or after words.
- **Use:** `iconPart(name, { size, place, words })` from `src/ui/parts/icon.ts`; the screens still call `icon(name, size, className)` from `src/icons.ts` until the Icon swap.
- **Variants:** sizes: 12, 16, 20, 24; places: alone, before, after
- **Code:** `src/ui/parts/icon.ts`, `src/icons.ts`
- **Styles:** `src/icons.css`
- **Options:** `src/ui/parts/icon-options.ts`
- **Tests:** `tests/icon-part.test.ts`
- **Design board:** Atoms › Icon

### Spinner

- **For:** A ring turning while something loads, inline or as an overlay over the panel that is loading.
- **Not for:** A control as small as its ring (overlay), or progress that can be measured (use the Progress bar).
- **Use:** `spinner({ size, place, label })` from `src/ui/parts/spinner.ts`; the caller marks the loading host `aria-busy="true"` and `inert`.
- **Variants:** sizes: small, medium, large; places: inline, overlay
- **Code:** `src/ui/parts/spinner.ts`
- **Styles:** `src/ui/parts/spinner.css`
- **Options:** `src/ui/parts/spinner-options.ts`
- **Tests:** `tests/spinner-progress-parts.test.ts`
- **Design board:** Atoms › Spinner

### Progress bar

- **For:** A bar that fills as far as a value says, or slides while nobody can tell how long it takes.
- **Use:** `progress({ value, max, label })` from `src/ui/parts/progress.ts`; move a bar already on the page with `setProgress(bar, options)` so it animates.
- **Variants:** steps: 0, 30, 60, 100
- **Code:** `src/ui/parts/progress.ts`
- **Styles:** `src/ui/parts/progress.css`
- **Options:** `src/ui/parts/progress-options.ts`
- **Tests:** `tests/spinner-progress-parts.test.ts`
- **Design board:** Atoms › Progress bar

### Badge

- **For:** A count, a status, a tag, a dot or a round mark, in one of six tones.
- **Use:** `badgePart({ kind, tone, words, icon })` from `src/ui/parts/badge.ts`, or `badgeMarkup(options)` from `src/ui/parts/badge-options.ts` for markup text.
- **Variants:** kinds: count, status, tag, dot, mark; tones: neutral, action, warning, question, success, danger
- **Code:** `src/ui/parts/badge.ts`
- **Styles:** `src/ui/parts/badge.css`
- **Options:** `src/ui/parts/badge-options.ts`
- **Tests:** `tests/badge-heading-key-parts.test.ts`, `tests/parts-list.test.ts`
- **Design board:** Atoms › Badge
- **Copies to swap:** the shared `.badge` in `src/style.css` and the badge looks screens style themselves (`node scripts/agents/copies.mjs report`).

### Section heading

- **For:** Small uppercase words naming a group in a panel or menu, with an optional end slot for a count or a button.
- **Use:** `sectionHeadingPart(words, { level, end })` from `src/ui/parts/section-heading.ts`.
- **Variants:** levels: 2, 3, 4
- **Code:** `src/ui/parts/section-heading.ts`
- **Styles:** `src/ui/parts/section-heading.css`
- **Options:** `src/ui/parts/section-heading-options.ts`
- **Tests:** `tests/badge-heading-key-parts.test.ts`
- **Design board:** Atoms › Section heading

### Keyboard key

- **For:** A key cap, or several keys pressed together, in a menu row, a tooltip or the shortcuts sheet.
- **Use:** `keyPart(keys)` from `src/ui/parts/key.ts` (a string or a list of keys).
- **Code:** `src/ui/parts/key.ts`
- **Styles:** `src/ui/parts/key.css`
- **Options:** `src/ui/parts/key-options.ts`
- **Tests:** `tests/badge-heading-key-parts.test.ts`
- **Design board:** Atoms › Keyboard key

### Inline field

- **For:** A text value in a panel row that reads as plain text and becomes a field on focus, with a red underline for an error.
- **Use:** class `inline-field` on the input; the panels listed at the top of `src/ui/inline-field.css` get it by selector.
- **Code:** none (styles only)
- **Styles:** `src/ui/inline-field.css`
- **Tests:** none yet
- **Design board:** Atoms › Inline field

## Shared pieces

Behaviour or looks several screens use. Reuse them the same way.

### Shared values

- **For:** The colours (light and dark), spacing, type sizes, corners, shadows and timings every part and screen styles with.
- **Use:** `var(--token)` in CSS; never a hand-typed px, colour or duration (the one-offs count, `scripts/agents/one-offs.mjs`, and `scripts/check-colours.mjs` hold this).
- **Code:** none (styles only)
- **Styles:** `src/theme.css`, `src/tokens/framework-editor.css`, `src/utilities.css`
- **Tests:** `tests/preview-menu.test.ts`, `tests/theme-scheme.test.ts`, `tests/theme-tokens.test.ts`

### Dropdown

- **For:** A menu that opens under its button (nonmodal): opening, closing on Escape and outside click, focus, placement.
- **Use:** `mountDropdown({ … })` from `src/components/dropdown.ts`.
- **Code:** `src/components/dropdown.ts`
- **Styles:** `src/components/dropdown.css`
- **Tests:** none yet

### Flyout

- **For:** A submenu beside a dropdown, opened from one of its rows.
- **Use:** `mountFlyout({ … })` from `src/components/flyout.ts`.
- **Code:** `src/components/flyout.ts`
- **Styles:** `src/components/flyout.css`
- **Tests:** none yet

### Row menu

- **For:** A menu of actions for one row (a page, a file, an element): items with an icon, a hint key, a disabled reason.
- **Use:** `createRowMenu(host, onClose)` from `src/components/row-menu.ts`, items as `MenuItem`.
- **Code:** `src/components/row-menu.ts`, `src/components/row-actions.ts`
- **Styles:** `src/components/row-menu.css`, `src/components/row-action-overlay.css`
- **Tests:** `tests/catalogue-parts.test.ts`, `tests/pages-and-files-host.test.ts`
- **Design board:** Molecules › Row menu

### Confirm dialog

- **For:** A modal question before an action that cannot be undone: a title, notes, the action and Cancel.
- **Use:** `createConfirmDialog(id)` from `src/components/confirm-dialog.ts`. Its look is the create dialog's (`src/components/create-dialog.css`).
- **Code:** `src/components/confirm-dialog.ts`
- **Tests:** `tests/lazy-loaders.test.ts`, `tests/pages-and-files-host.test.ts`
- **Design board:** Molecules › Confirm dialog
- **Copies to swap:** dialogs made by hand and their backdrops (`node scripts/agents/copies.mjs report`); one Dialog part is planned.

### Field suggestions

- **For:** A suggestion list anchored to a text field (a URL's pages, an image's files), with keyboard choice.
- **Use:** `attachFieldSuggestions(input, entries, label)` from `src/components/field-suggestions.ts`; rows from `suggestionLines()` in `src/components/suggestion-rows.ts`.
- **Code:** `src/components/field-suggestions.ts`, `src/components/suggestion-rows.ts`
- **Styles:** `src/components/field-suggestions.css`, `src/components/suggestion-rows.css`
- **Tests:** none yet

### Resize handle

- **For:** A splitter that resizes a panel by drag and toggles it by click or key.
- **Use:** `createGrip()` and `trackPress(handle, handlers)` from `src/components/resize-handle.ts`.
- **Code:** `src/components/resize-handle.ts`
- **Styles:** `src/components/resize-handle.css`
- **Tests:** none yet

### Spotlight

- **For:** Dims the page, rings one element and shows a callout beside it with a title, text and buttons.
- **Use:** `spotlight(target, options)` from `src/components/spotlight.ts`; placement in `src/components/spotlight-layout.ts`.
- **Code:** `src/components/spotlight.ts`, `src/components/spotlight-layout.ts`
- **Styles:** `src/components/spotlight.css`
- **Tests:** `tests/lazy-loaders.test.ts`, `tests/spotlight.test.ts`

### Refusal note

- **For:** Says why an action cannot run, next to the control that was used.
- **Use:** `refuse(reason, near)` from `src/components/refusal-note.ts`.
- **Code:** `src/components/refusal-note.ts`
- **Styles:** `src/components/refusal-note.css`
- **Tests:** `tests/announce.test.ts`, `tests/command-palette-controller.test.ts`, `tests/preview-wire.test.ts`, `tests/refusal-note.test.ts`

### Done mark

- **For:** Shows a finished action on the menu button that ran it: its icon turns into a check for a moment.
- **Use:** `markDone(control, ms)` from `src/ui/done-mark.ts`.
- **Code:** `src/ui/done-mark.ts`
- **Tests:** none yet

### Person chip

- **For:** Someone in a synced session by initial, in the top bar and on the guest page.
- **Use:** class `person-chip` (and `person-chip--more` for the rest count).
- **Code:** none (styles only)
- **Styles:** `src/components/person-chip.css`
- **Tests:** none yet

### Found announcer

- **For:** Tells a screen reader what a search found once the typing rests.
- **Use:** `sayFound(region, text)` and `foundCount(count, noun)` from `src/ui/say-found.ts`.
- **Code:** `src/ui/say-found.ts`
- **Tests:** none yet

### Media form fields

- **For:** A labelled text field, select or tick box (with an optional hint line) in the Media screens' sheets.
- **Use:** `input(label, type)`, `select(label, choices)`, `field(label, control)`, `check(label, control, hint)` from `src/page-builder/media-library-fields.ts`.
- **Code:** `src/page-builder/media-library-fields.ts`
- **Tests:** none yet

### Editor scrollbars

- **For:** The thin scrollbars of the editor's own panels.
- **Code:** none (styles only)
- **Styles:** `src/ui/editor-scrollbars.css`
- **Tests:** none yet
